interface.shortDescription: Prepare Swiss trademark filings with local IPI, Nice, Swissreg, and TAF sources.
interface.longDescription: An open-source, offline-first assistant for Swiss intellectual property lawyers preparing trademark deposits before the IPI. Co-authored by ogram.ch and enodo.ch, it combines a structured practitioner workflow with four local MCP servers over NCL(13-2026) headings, WDL terms, Swissreg professional examples, TAF precedent extracts, filing-intake checks, sign-risk screening, and clearance planning.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Swiss trademark deposit for my activity.
Draft Swiss Nice labels for these services.
Analyze absolute grounds for this Swiss mark.
